svg.aria-label: Without Ambit: Alice, Dan and Bob share one team API key and call models directly, an AI agent reaches work apps through a shared service account, Bob's key still works after he left, there is no record and the cost appears on next month's bill. With Ambit: everyone passes the Ambit gateway, which checks who they are, what they may use and their daily limit, records every call, and refuses Bob.
svg.title: Why Ambit: without it, people share one key and nobody can say who did what; with it, every call is checked, limited and recorded.
